translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Yesus kinim mak kasáya dausa umi sung uta ko.
Kale yanol Yesus ayo yak Yedusalem Yu kayak imin ban bobiw unsa.
Kale Yedusalem be wok mik mak Siwsiw Awsom mewsono kalomo, wok mik win Adameik im weng Betseidda kalbiw, wok mik kinang kinang be, kasadam auok kal mak falala dausiwo kale.
Kinim mafak iwán seng seng, sák kukmálin banim so kun iwán so kin mat so ika akál bom tein bom wok mik kukmálako, kale fenábiw uyo watawo kaleyo bá,
kalo makalo Got ami ensel ayo madák wok mik ili falfalawane, kale kinim kan ata asik gebom dák wok kumun una namti, ata alam iwánsa uyo kenámaliwo kale.
Kinim mak aka kukmálongin danim bom bada bi itol 38 kal aka akálin kuw bom biyaba. Kale itol deng mak ade bati kal mak taw keisa.
Kale Yesus aka atamomo akálin kuw biyámala ka. Kale nadale alam kal keidomo kinim beyo itol seng kámongin danim keisa ka. Kale nadale dákadálaw, “kaba kasáim keidono kalbáwe?” Akane,

asanin kinim ayo fakadu bakodaw, “kawta, naka kinim kan ata tad namadew dák wok kumun kukmálba tem dádayo naka kenomi banim. Naka dák unono kalomane, madik isik gebom dák uniw kala, kalanábino.” Akane,
Yesus ayo bakodaw, “iwán kaba kan tod kalam abin kon uyo kudew tod tod unalo!” Akei,
kei badane, beta wabising kinim ayo kasáya alam abin kon uyo kudew kan tod unsa. Kale am kanosa be Finuyámin atan kal ko.
Kale Yu kayak iyo kinim kasáya ayo bakodaw, “kamane uyo ki Finuyámin atan kale weng abem uyo bako, kabalam abin kon uyo kudew kámin báyo káku ko.” Akiwe,
aka fakadu bakoyam, “kinim kasáya namuda alata bakonam, ‘kalam abin kon uyo fidu kudew unalo!’ Naka kala.” Yakane,
ika bakodaw, “be yaknámin kinim ata bakokam, ‘abin kon fidu kudew unalo!’ Kakane,” akaniwe,
Yesus ayo kalo kinim tem namas kala kayo kinim ayo bako, kan ata kidela namuda kaloma banim.
Kale yanol Yesus ayo Yol am kal, kinim ayo atam nadane bakodaw, “kaba kalam ban keimin uyo kudálal kala, masi kanamom kalam kál funin uyo makso kudulolaw.” Akeisa.
Kale kinim ayo yak nadane Yu kayak bakoyam, “kinim kasáya namuse ayo Yesus atano.” Kalesa ko.
Kaleyo Yesus ayo Finuyámin atan kal kanodin ufek ufek uyo kana badano kayo, Yu kayak iyo daw mafak dákansiw.
Kale Yesus ayo bakoyam, “nam Natim ayo ulum kano sun kuw wok faku kudew tad kamane so di kanaba ade naka nalaso kanabi.”

Kal badano kayo, Yu kayak iyo Yesus anbiduw, fikalako kanamiw uyo Finuyámin atan umi sawa kuw lukelba. Akei nadiwo bá, kata am weng so bako nada “Got be nalam Natimo” kalba. Be ika atamomo am weng bakaba uyo naka Got alataw kalin taw kei be ka. Kalom nadiwo kayo ko.

Yesus ayo fakadu bakoyam, “naka atin afan bakanyabi, Min ayo ken alafin ufek ufek kanamoma bá, aka alam Alaw atama kanaba ki kanamala uyo watawo kaleyo bá, Alaw alam kanaba ki Min akal alaso kanamala.
Kale Alaw ayo Min aket kudawsa, kayo kukuw adikum kanaba uyo kukudawába kala. Kale kamane kanamin kukuw katiw utamanbiw. Kata am kukuw dukum uyo yanol kanodano, kiba aket madiw kalokabiw.
Kale Natim ayo fikalenámin uyo tá imu nada kaunsin sinik dauyamse. Kale ami aket kanamsa kaí, Min asik Alaw aket ki kudu nada asik yak kan ata alam aket kudawa be ayo kaunsin sinik kukádaba kala.
Kale maksino Alaw aka kinim mak afeta imudongin danim, kata afetin kukuw uyo atin adikum kudála yak Min ami dim abu, Min ata fakube kala.

Kaleyo wanang kinim adikum Min ken win kufádawin uyo, Alaw win kufádawin ulutaw keidawin kala. Kale kan ata Min ami win so kufádawongin banim namti, Min dabadála tasa ami Alaw win so kufádawongin danim ka.

Naka atin afan bakayabi, kale kan kinim ata nam weng kidiba namti, Got namadála tasi alaso aket kukádaba ka. Aka lim tuwámin sinik so be ade aka daw mafak dádoma banim kei nada aka fikalanámin bán bu kudá akamam nada yak kaunsin biyámin bán tase kala.
Kale naka atin afan bakayabi, am dánámin uyo mewso keibu ade kamane kal keidu, kale fikalinámin iyo Got ami Min weng kidilokabiw ade kan ita kidilokabiw ika kaunsin sinik kudu bokabiw.
Kata Alaw aka kaunsin sinik kale Min akal abin kudawa matam kaunsin sinik keiba kala.
Kaleyo Got ayo alam Min kitid kudawa kinim afetba uyo watawo kaleyo bá, aka Got ami Kinim kayo ko.
Kiba weng bela kidi aket madiw kaliw namti, weng belayo kidilin, am dánámin mew tadbu, kale adikum fikalanin iyo ilim fom lung tein bidiw ika am weng kidilokabiw kala.
Kale ika fom lung kudá matam bokabiw kala. Kale yaknámin kinim ata kidel kuw keimúsa namti, ata ken bokaba ka. Yak kan kinim ata mafak kuw keimúsa namti, aka daw mafak dádokaba.

Kale naka ufek ufek mak nalam aket tei kanamomi danim, kata naka afetin uyo nalam Natim weng kidi nadino kuw kanamokabi, beta nam afetin uyo kidel keidokabu kala. Kale be watawo kaleyo bá, naka nalam aket tei kanamomi bá, kata Natim namadála tasi, am aket fukanin uta kunamano, kuw kanamin kayo ko.”
Yesus kin wala nada bakanin weng sung uta ko.
“Alo naka nalata asiki nalam kin walamin keidokabi namti, kiba nam kin walamin weng uyo kidi au, afan kaloliw banim.
Kata Natim ata nam kin walamin kinim, kale naka nalam kal, ami nam sung kidel bakanba uyo atin afan.
Kiba weng kudáliw yak Yon atamu am kin walamin weng bakoda kidi nadiwade am kin walamin weng uyo bakanyamsa be atin afan ko.
Kale kinim imi kin walamin weng uyo báyo kalbi, kata naka beta bakoyamino uta watakoyamokabu kala.
Kale Yon aka yakom kaifodin taw kei nada lánin kuyama. Kiba ami lánámin aket kumam kalfalbiw.

Kata nam kin walamin uta amsun, Yon ami kin walamin be katiw. Kale Natim wok kunama fakusi uyo atin kilá faká teidokabi ade kamane faku bom bi uta kukuyamu kilim kal keidomo, Natim ata namadála tasi kalokabiw.
Kale Natim namadála tasi alata ki nam kin walamin keiba ayo kiba am weng kidilongin danim, am kibi uyo atamongin danim
ade am weng uyo kudew yak aket dádongin danim. Ade kiba be watawo kaleyo kinim dabadála tase ayo aket kudawongin banim.
Kiba Got ami buk weng godin seng kímaliw, ayo watawo kaleyo bá, sun biyámin sinik uta kudulumo, kale nadiwo kayo ka. Kale belami buk godin weng sung beyo ki nam sung bakanbu.
Kata kiba mak maek nam mit tem tadongin danim, kale kiba sun sinik biyámin uyo kuduloliw bá ko.
Naka kinim im kalfalin bo kudulomi banim.
Kata kiba nalam kal, naka nalam kal keidomo, kiba Got kukuw kidel uyo kim aket tem mak bongin banim.
Kayo naka Natim alam win tudow dim tasi, kata kiba namudulongin danim, kata kan kinim ata alam win tudow dim tadoma, ata kiba wabising dabuduloliw kate.
Kiba akanum win dukum bede kudawa kudawa keimaliw, kata kiba win dukum Got amiyo tadebu uyo kudulumo kaloliw banim. Kale kiba yakno yakno kal kei afan kalokabiwe?
Kata kiba, kim aket fukanin bo kim kukuw mafak mafak uyo nata Natim dim weng fine bakoyamokabi bá, kata kim kukuw mafak umi weng fine be Mosus, kilim mimin dok di ata dakoyamokabano kalesiw ata ka.
Kiba Mosus aket kudawiw namti, bo nam aket kukánamin uta ka. Watawo kaleyo bá, aka nami guton uta godusa make.
Kata kiba am weng godusa uyo afan kalongin danim, kale yakno yakno nam weng bakanbi uyo afano kalokabiwe?” Yakeisa ko.
